meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 这个技能帮助修改 NanoClaw 的行为或增加新功能。它会先问几个问题弄清你的需求，然后按步骤改动设置，并告诉你怎么检查效果。
howto.when: 当你想添加 Telegram、Slack 等新渠道，或调整触发词、接入外部工具时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加为输入渠道
say.note: 会询问目标 agent group 和隔离级别

say.text: 给“查天气”这个触发词加一条规则
say.note: 会更新对应接线的触发规则

say.text: 给某个 agent group 加日历工具
say.note: 会调用 /add-gcal-tool 或修改容器配置

howto.what_en: This skill helps modify NanoClaw's behavior or add new capabilities. It asks clarifying questions first, then plans and implements changes on the right surface, and gives you steps to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add a new channel like Telegram or Slack, adjust trigger rules, wire in external integrations, or otherwise customize NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: Asks about the target agent group and isolation level

say_en.text: Add a trigger rule for the phrase 'check weather'
say_en.note: Updates the trigger rules of the matching wiring

say_en.text: Add a calendar tool to an agent group
say_en.note: Uses /add-gcal-tool or edits the container config
